summary: React to what happens in the game, and send messages between resources, the server and players' games. Handlers from Events.on run in the order added. Where an event says "Return false to refuse", one handler returning false is enough to refuse the action.

on.summary: Runs the handler each time the event happens, for the game's events and your own from Events.emit alike.

params.name: The event name.
params.fn: The handler, which gets the event's arguments.

once.summary: Runs the handler the next time the event happens, then removes it.

off.summary: Removes a handler added with on or once.
off.exampleLua:
local greet = function(player)
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Welcome!")
end

kcds.core.Events.on("playerReady", greet)
kcds.core.Events.off("playerReady", greet)

emit.summary: Raises an event for all resources on this side, the server or this player's game. The promise settles once all handlers have run, and rejects with an AggregateError if any threw.
emit.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("roundStarted", function(round)
  print("round " .. tostring(round))
end)

kcds.core.Events.emit("roundStarted", 3)

toResource.summary: Raises an event for one resource only, by its name. Other resources do not hear it.

params....args: The resource's name, the event name, then the arguments.

toResource.example:
// Only the 'economy' resource hears it, through Events.on('economy:pay').
await kcds.core.Events.toResource('economy', 'economy:pay', player.id, 25);
toResource.exampleLua:
-- Only the 'economy' resource hears it, through Events.on('economy:pay').
kcds.core.Events.toResource("economy", "economy:pay", player.id, 25):await()
toResource.exampleCs:
// Only the 'economy' resource hears it, through Events.on('economy:pay').
await Events.ToResource("economy", "economy:pay", player.Id, 25);

listen.summary: Listens to an event this resource raises with fire. Other resources can neither hear nor raise it.

fire.summary: Raises a private event, heard only by this resource's listen handlers.

params....args: The event name, then the arguments.

listenerCount.summary: How many handlers this side has for an event.
listenerCount.exampleLua:
if kcds.core.Events.listenerCount("playerChat") == 0 then
  print("no resource handles chat")
end

broadcast.summary: Sends an event to all connected players' games. Client handlers from Events.on get the payload parsed from JSON, up to 32 KB. A string that is JSON text is sent as is, and any other string arrives as that string.

params....args: The event name, then one payload value.

broadcast.exampleLua:
-- server
kcds.core.Events.broadcast("scoreboard", { red = 3, blue = 5 })

-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("scoreboard", function(score)
  print(score.red, score.blue)
end)

fromClient.summary: Listens to an event sent by a player's game with Events.toServer. The handler gets the sender and the payload parsed from JSON. A changed client can send anything, so check the payload.
fromClient.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.fromClient("requestHeal", function(player)
  if player.ableToAct then
    player:heal()
  end
end)

onceFromClient.summary: As fromClient, for the next arrival only.
onceFromClient.exampleLua:
-- The first player to ring the bell wins.
kcds.core.Events.onceFromClient("race:bell", function(player)
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(tostring(player.nickname) .. " rang the bell first!")
end)

offFromClient.summary: Removes a handler added with fromClient or onceFromClient.
offFromClient.exampleLua:
local vote = function(player, payload)
  tally(player, payload)
end

kcds.core.Events.fromClient("vote:cast", vote)
kcds.core.Events.offFromClient("vote:cast", vote)

toServer.summary: Sends an event from this player's game to the server, where Events.fromClient handlers get it with the sender. The payload goes as JSON, up to 32 KB. A string that is JSON text is sent as is, and any other string arrives as that string.

params....args: The event name, then one payload value.

resourceStart.summary: A resource's scripts have run. Each side raises it for its own resources.
resourceStart.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("resourceStart", function(name)
  if name ~= "hello" then
    return
  end
  -- Resources that depend on this one wait for the promise it answers.
  return loadSavedData()
end)

resourceStop.summary: A resource is stopping, and handlers have up to 10 seconds to finish.

consoleCommand.summary: Someone typed a command in the server console that the server does not handle itself.
consoleCommand.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("consoleCommand", function(command, parts)
  if command == "announce" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(table.concat(parts, " "), { author = "Server" })
  end
end)

worldResourcesReady.summary: All world resources, the level edits and their exports, have loaded.

playerConnecting.summary: Someone asks to join, before their connection exists. They get in once all handlers have returned and all returned promises have settled, and a handler that throws or rejects turns them away. `request.reject(reason)` turns them away at once, with up to 512 bytes of text. `request.update(message)` shows up to 256 bytes on their waiting screen and restarts the wait. `nickname`, `steamId`, `epicId`, `store`, `storeAccount`, `discordId` (with `discordVerified`), `deviceId` and `ip` say who it is, as on a player, with `identifiers` listing them as { kind, id, verified } and `getIdentifier(kind)` giving one, or ''. `ticket` is the KCDS Master's join pass, already checked, and a backend can check it again with the Master's public key. `joinToken` is the text the player's launcher passed with --join-token when it started KCDS straight into this server, such as a one-time ticket of your own launcher, or '': 1 to 255 letters, digits and - _ . ~ + / = :, not checked by KCDS. `isPending()` says whether it still waits. A player on the KCDS central ban list gets no pass and so never gets this far, nor does one without the server's password, KCDS_SERVER_PASSWORD.
playerConnecting.exampleLua:
local banned = { ["steam:76561198000000001"] = true }

kcds.core.Events.on("playerConnecting", function(request)
  local steam = request:getIdentifier("steam")
  if banned["steam:" .. tostring(steam)] then
    request:reject("You are banned from this server.")
    return
  end
  -- a handler cannot wait, so it answers the promise: the join waits for it
  return serverIsFull():next(function(full)
    if full then
      request:reject("The server is full, try again later.")
    end
  end)
end)

playerConnect.summary: A player joined. Their body and inventory exist while they are still loading, which makes this the place to restore a saved inventory.
playerConnect.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerConnect", function(player)
  local saved = savedInventories:get(player.steamId)
  if saved then
    kcds.players.Inventory.set(player, { items = saved.items, quickslots = saved.quickslots })
  end
end)

playerSpawning.summary: Their game has loaded and needs a starting place. Give it here with player.spawn(position, rotation).

playerSpawned.summary: The player stands in the loaded world.

localVoiceTransmitting.summary: Client only. This player's voice started or stopped going out: they hold the talk key, or voice activation heard them.
localVoiceTransmitting.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("localVoiceTransmitting", function(transmitting)
  print(transmitting and "on air" or "quiet")
end)

loadingProgress.summary: Client only. How far the game has loaded, for a server's loading page: stage 'resources', 'level' or 'ready', with a percentage. See LoadingScreen. Scripts do not run yet during 'download', which only the page hears.
loadingProgress.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("loadingProgress", function(stage, percent)
  print(tostring(stage) .. " " .. tostring(percent))
end)

playerReady.summary: Their game has taken down its loading screen, so they can see and play. It fires once per connection, on the server and in the player's own game.
playerReady.exampleLua:
-- server
kcds.core.Events.on("playerReady", function(player)
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Welcome, " .. player.nickname .. "!")
end)

-- client: the argument is the local player
kcds.core.Events.on("playerReady", function()
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Welcome!")
end)

playerResourcesReady.summary: Server only. Their game has downloaded and started the client resources, so events from player.emit and Events.broadcast now reach their client scripts. On a first join, playerReady can come first. It fires again when client resources load anew, and when their game restarts client scripts that stopped by themselves, which it does up to 5 times a session. Those scripts then hold nothing, so send what they need again.

playerDisconnect.summary: A player left. The object still has its last values here, so save what you need.

playerChat.summary: A player sent a chat message that is not a command. By default it has already gone to everyone. To handle chat yourself, use Chat.setChatRelay(false).

playerCommand.summary: A player typed a message starting with /. You get the command without the slash, and the rest split at spaces. Commands never go to other players.
args: The command word, without the slash.
playerCommand.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command, args)
  if string.lower(command) == "hello" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, table.concat(args, " ") or "Hello!", { author = "Server" })
  end
end)

playerStatsChanged.summary: Stats in a player's report changed, with one event for all changes of a server tick.
args: An array of { stat, previous, current }.
playerStatsChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerStatsChanged", function(player, changes)
  for _, change in ipairs(changes) do
    if change.stat == "hunger" and change.current < 10 then
      kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You are starving.")
    end
  end
end)

playerDamage.summary: A player's game took health off them.
args: 'head', 'torso', 'leftArm', 'rightArm', 'leftLeg', 'rightLeg' or null. A melee blow names the part it landed on, whether a player or an NPC struck it. Health taken by anything else has null: a fall, a collision (a horse, a trample), an arrow or bolt, bleeding, poison and starvation.

Why the health was lost: 'combat' (a melee blow or an arrow), 'collision' (a horse or a body running into them), 'fall', 'bleeding', 'poison', 'starvation', 'scripted' (a game script or a resource's setHealth), 'gunshot', 'disintegrate', 'selfHarm' or 'unknown'.
playerDamage.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerDamage", function(player, attacker, amount, bodyPart)
  if bodyPart == "head" and amount > 30 then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "A hard blow to the head!")
  end
end)

playerHit.summary: Another player's blow, arrow, bolt or ball is about to take a player's health. Set hit.damage for the health it takes, or hit.modifiers (attack, defense, block, health, where 1 changes nothing) to have the game work out the blow again. Return false to refuse. A hit on or by a player in a dice match, or at a smithy, alchemy table or grindstone, is refused before this event.
args: The blow: damage, priced, weapon, attack, armor, blockDefense, bodyPartCoefficient, bodyPart, source ('melee' or 'missile'), blocked, perfectBlock, blockBroken, stamina and modifiers.
playerHit.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerHit", function(player, attacker, hit)
  if safeZone:holdsEntity(player) then
    return false
  end
  hit.modifiers.attack = 1.5
end)

playerAttack.summary: The server accepted a player's melee swing at another player.
playerAttack.exampleLua:
-- No fighting in the market square.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerAttack", function(player, opponent)
  if marketSquare:contains(player.position) then
    player:stopFight(opponent)
  end
end)

playerCombatCancelled.summary: player.stopFight ended melee combat between two players.

playerDied.summary: A player was knocked out, and stays down until player.revive().
args: The player who dealt the last damage shortly before, or null.
That damage's reason, as in playerDamage, or 'unknown'.
playerDied.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerDied", function(player, killer)
  if killer then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(killer.nickname .. " knocked out " .. player.nickname)
  end
  setTimeout(function() return player:revive() end, 30000)
end)

playerBuffAdded.summary: A status effect landed on a player.
args: 'server' if a script added it, 'native' if the game did.
playerBuffAdded.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerBuffAdded", function(player, buff, source)
  if source == "native" then
    print(player.nickname .. " got " .. tostring(buff) .. " from the game")
  end
end)

playerBuffRemoved.summary: A status effect left a player.
playerBuffRemoved.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerBuffRemoved", function(player, buff)
  if buff == "drunk" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Your head clears.")
  end
end)

playerBuffBlocked.summary: The server's rules stopped the game putting a status effect on a player.

playerCustomBuffApply.summary: An instance of a Buffs.register buff landed on a player, firing for each stack.
args: { name, its id; class 'custom'; aiTag null; duration; custom true; displayName; description }.

playerCustomBuffTick.summary: A tick of a Buffs.register buff with a tickInterval, once per instance and interval.
args: { name, its id; class 'custom'; aiTag null; duration; custom true; displayName; description }.
playerCustomBuffTick.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCustomBuffTick", function(player, buff)
  if buff.name == "myres:blessing" then
    player:addStat("health", 1)
  end
end)

playerCustomBuffRemove.summary: An instance of a Buffs.register buff left a player, whose modifiers no longer apply.
args: { name, its id; class 'custom'; aiTag null; duration; custom true; displayName; description }.
'expired', 'server' for removeBuff, 'refreshed' for a new stack replacing it, or 'disconnect'.
playerCustomBuffRemove.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCustomBuffRemove", function(player, buff, reason)
  if reason == "expired" then
    print(tostring(buff.displayName) .. " wore off " .. player.nickname)
  end
end)

playerWeaponHit.summary: A swing struck the world and not a character, such as a tree, wall, rock, prop or the ground. It fires once per object per attack, on first contact, from the attacker's client report. The server accepts a report up to 8 m from the player's known position, and up to 16 per second per player. Unarmed attacks never fire it, and hits on players, NPCs and animals are for playerHit and the damage events.
args: As a World.raycast result: position, normal, surface, kind, model, category and levelObject, which LevelEdit.apply takes to fell or break it, with distance in metres from the feet.
playerWeaponHit.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerWeaponHit", function(player, hit)
  if hit.category == "tree" and hit.distance < 3 then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You notch the " .. hit.model or "tree" .. ".")
  end
end)

playerAnimationEnd.summary: An animation from player.playAnimation ended, firing once per request: a fragment, or a clip played with an empty fragment (`{ clip }`).
args: The fragment, or '' for a clip, and for a tags-only request refused because none of its tags fits the body.

'finished', 'interrupted', 'refused', 'stopped' or 'replaced'. A clip finishes when it played to its end, is interrupted when the game played something else on its layer, and is refused when the game did not start it.
The clip, for a clip played with an empty fragment; '' otherwise.
playerAnimationEnd.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerAnimationEnd", function(player, fragment, reason)
  if fragment == "Greetings" and reason == "finished" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "A fine bow.")
  end
end)

propPickedUp.summary: An animation's pickup took a playAnimation prop with fromAnimation into the hand.
args: { index, fragment, hand, item, model, rest }: its place in props, the animation, 'right' or 'left', the item class id or mesh, and the Prop it rests as, or null.
propPickedUp.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("propPickedUp", function(player, prop)
  if prop.fragment == "GetMash" then
    print(player.nickname .. " scoops soup")
  end
end)

propPlaced.summary: An animation put down a playAnimation prop with fromAnimation.
propPlaced.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("propPlaced", function(player, prop)
  if prop.rest then
    print("the scoop lies at " .. tostring(prop.rest.id) .. " again")
  end
end)

playerCuffedChange.summary: player.setCuffed cuffed or uncuffed a player.

args: 'script' for releaseFromPillory, 'lockpicked' for another player picking the lock.
playerPilloryReleased.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPilloryReleased", function(player, reason)
  if reason == "lockpicked" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll("Someone freed " .. player.nickname .. " from the pillory!")
  end
end)

playerWhistle.summary: A player whistled for their horse, and nearby players hear it.

playerCarrying.summary: A player is about to lift a knocked-out player onto their shoulder. Return false to refuse.
playerCarrying.exampleLua:
-- Only guards carry the unconscious.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCarrying", function(carrier)
  if carrier.state:get("job") ~= "guard" then
    return false
  end
end)

playerCarry.summary: A player lifted a knocked-out player onto their shoulder.

playerPutDown.summary: A carried player was put down.

playerCarryingItem.summary: A player is about to pick up a carryable item from the ground in their arms. Return false to refuse.
playerCarryingItem.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCarryingItem", function(player, item)
  if item == "barrel" and player.state:get("job") ~= "brewer" then
    return false
  end
end)

playerCarryItem.summary: A player now carries an item in their arms.
args: The GroundItem it came from, or null.

playerPutDownItem.summary: A player stopped carrying an item and set it down.
args: Always null, since the item becomes a new GroundItem where it lands.

playerInventoryChanged.summary: Rows in a player's inventory were added, removed, moved or changed.
args: { revision, reason, items: [{ id, before, after }] }, with after null for a removed row.
playerInventoryChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerInventoryChanged", function(player, change)
  if change.reason == "loot" then
    print(player.nickname .. " looted something")
  end
end)

playerInventoryReady.summary: A player's game shows the inventory the server holds for them. It fires once.

playerItemUsed.summary: A player used up units of an item. For eating and drinking, see playerConsumed.
playerItemUsed.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerItemUsed", function(player, item, kind, amount)
  if kind == "shot" then
    arrowsShot:set(player.id, (arrowsShot:get(player.id) or 0) + amount)
  end
end)

playerConsuming.summary: A player is about to eat or drink. Return false to refuse.
args: { source, item, kind: 'food' | 'potion', baseEffects, rowId, potGuid, metadata, poison, nativeEffects }.
playerConsuming.exampleLua:
-- No potions during a duel.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerConsuming", function(player, consumption)
  if consumption.kind == "potion" and player.state:get("inDuel") then
    return false
  end
end)

playerConsumptionEffects.summary: Follows playerConsuming. Return false to stop the game's effects of the food or drink, so your script can apply its own. The item is still used up.
playerConsumptionEffects.exampleLua:
-- This server's bread has its own effects.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerConsumptionEffects", function(player, consumption)
  if consumption.item == breadItemId then
    return false
  end
end)

playerPoisonAbsorbing.summary: A player consumed something poisoned and is about to get the poison. Return false to keep it off them.
playerPoisonAbsorbing.exampleLua:
-- An antidote ring protects its wearer.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPoisonAbsorbing", function(player)
  if player.state:get("antidote") then
    return false
  end
end)

playerConsumed.summary: A player ate or drank something.
args: { source: 'inventory' | 'pot', item, kind, baseEffects, rowId, potGuid, metadata, poison, nativeEffects }.
playerConsumed.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerConsumed", function(player, consumed)
  if consumed.poison then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "That tasted strange...")
  end
end)

playerCustomItemUse.summary: A player used a custom item your resource made usable with Items.
args: The inventory's revision at that moment.
playerCustomItemUse.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCustomItemUse", function(player, item)
  if item.item == letter.id then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "The seal breaks.")
  end
end)

playerLoot.summary: A player is about to take an item from a knocked-out player's body. Return false to refuse.
playerLoot.exampleLua:
-- The purse stays with its owner.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerLoot", function(player, victim, line)
  if line.item == moneyItemId then
    return false
  end
end)

playerInventoryTake.summary: A player is about to take an item from another player's inventory through a view of it (Stash.playerInventory). Return false to refuse.
args: The player whose inventory it is.
{ item, row, amount, worn }, where worn is whether the owner wears units of the row.
playerInventoryTake.exampleLua:
-- Admins may not strip the armour off another admin.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerInventoryTake", function(player, owner, line)
  if line.worn and owner.state:get("role") == "admin" then
    return false
  end
end)

playerInventoryTaken.summary: A player took items from another player's inventory through a view of it (Stash.playerInventory).
args: The player they were taken from.

playerInventoryGive.summary: A player is about to give an item from their own inventory into another player's, through a view that takes puts (Stash.playerInventory with put: true). Return false to refuse.
args: { item, row, amount }, the giver's row.
playerInventoryGive.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerInventoryGive", function(player, owner, line)
  if line.amount > 100 then
    return false
  end
end)

playerInventoryGiven.summary: A player gave items into another player's inventory through a view of it (Stash.playerInventory with put: true).

playerLooted.summary: A player took items from a knocked-out player's body.

playerPickpocketStart.summary: A player tries to pickpocket another. Return false to refuse.
playerPickpocketStart.exampleLua:
-- No stealing from new players.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPickpocketStart", function(thief, victim)
  if victim.state:get("newcomer") then
    return false
  end
end)

playerPickpocketed.summary: A pickpocketing ended, with the items taken.

playerXpGaining.summary: A player's game is about to grant XP. Return false to refuse.
args: What earned it, by the game's name.
playerXpGaining.exampleLua:
-- No XP from fighting in the training yard.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerXpGaining", function(player, track)
  if track == "fighting" and trainingYard:contains(player.position) then
    return false
  end
end)

playerXpGained.summary: A player gained XP on a skill track.

playerLevelUp.summary: A player reached a new level on a skill track.

playerPerkLearning.summary: A player chooses a perk. Return false to cancel the choice.
playerPerkLearning.exampleLua:
-- No perks before level 5 on this server.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPerkLearning", function(player)
  if player.level < 5 then
    return false
  end
end)

playerProgressionRejected.summary: A player's game reported XP or perks the server did not grant. What happens to the player is up to your resources.

nativeMenuOpened.summary: The game's Esc menu opened in this game. It is checked ten times a second, so it comes within a tenth of a second.
nativeMenuOpened.exampleLua:
-- client: your own panel goes away under the game's menu
local panel = kcds.ui.Web.open("kcds://resources/my_hud/ui/panel.html", { width = 300, height = 120 })
kcds.core.Events.on("nativeMenuOpened", function()
  kcds.ui.Web.hide(panel)
end)

nativeMenuClosed.summary: The game's Esc menu closed in this game, after `nativeMenuOpened`.
nativeMenuClosed.exampleLua:
-- client
local panel = kcds.ui.Web.open("kcds://resources/my_hud/ui/panel.html", { width = 300, height = 120 })
kcds.core.Events.on("nativeMenuClosed", function()
  kcds.ui.Web.show(panel)
end)

cursorVisibilityChanged.summary: The mouse pointer showed or went away in this game: a resource's `Controls.showCursor`, a focused page or the chat. It comes once for each change, with what `Controls.isCursorVisible()` now says.
cursorVisibilityChanged.exampleLua:
-- client: the camera stays still while any pointer shows
kcds.core.Events.on("cursorVisibilityChanged", function(visible)
  if visible then
    kcds.ui.Controls.blockAction("rotateyaw")
  else
    kcds.ui.Controls.unblockAction("rotateyaw")
  end
end)

playerTeleported.summary: A player a script moved (`player.teleport`, `player.position = ...`) now stands there: their own game reported the body within 3 m of the target. Until then `player.position` gives the target, and then again the body's real place from their reports. A move that never arrives is forgotten after 15 seconds, without the event.
args: Where their game reported the body.

playerStanceChanged.summary: A player's own game chose another stance tag for their body (`player.bodyStance` on the server): standing, crouched, sitting and the others, as raw tag ids. Not raised for the first report after joining.
args: The new stance tag, or 255 for none.

chatKey.summary: The player pressed the chat key (T) while a resource hid the game's chat with `Chat.setUIVisible(false)`. Nothing opened; open your own chat window here. The game still gets the key.
chatKey.exampleLua:
-- client: your own chat window instead of the game's
local Web, Controls = kcds.ui.Web, kcds.ui.Controls
local chatWindow = Web.open("kcds://resources/my_chat/ui/chat.html", { width = 480, height = 320, visible = false })
kcds.core.Chat.setUIVisible(false)
kcds.core.Events.on("chatKey", function()
  Web.show(chatWindow)
  Web.focus(chatWindow)
  Controls.showCursor()
end)

chatMessage.summary: A chat message arrived in this player's game.
chatMessage.exampleLua:
-- client: a notice when someone writes the player's name
kcds.core.Events.on("chatMessage", function(message)
  local me = kcds.players.LocalPlayer
  local name = me and me.nickname
  if name and string.find(message.text, name, 1, true) then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification(message.author .. " mentioned you")
  end
end)

progressionXpGained.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("progressionXpGained", function(track, xp)
  print("+" .. tostring(xp) .. " " .. tostring(track))
end)

progressionLevelUp.summary: The local player reached a new level.
progressionLevelUp.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("progressionLevelUp", function(track, level)

end)

noclipChanged.summary: NoClip went on or off for the local player.
args: 'script', or what ended it: 'sessionOver', 'viewLost', or 'notAllowed' if the server forbade it through Player.noclipAllowed.
noclipChanged.exampleLua:

kcds.core.Events.on("noclipChanged", function(enabled)

end)

args: Whether the local player can fly now.

  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification((allowed and "You can fly (F3)." or "Flying is off for you."))
end)

mapOpened.summary: The local player opened the map.

mapClosed.summary: The local player closed the map.
mapClosed.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("mapClosed", function()
  kcds.ui.Hud.setHudPart("Compass", true)
end)

weaponHit.summary: The local player's weapon struck the world and not a character, such as a tree, wall, rock, prop or the ground. It fires once per object per attack, on first contact, and not again while the blade stays against it. Unarmed attacks never fire it, and hits on players, NPCs and animals are for playerHit and the damage events. The server's event is playerWeaponHit. Handler promises are not awaited.
args: As a World.raycast result: position, normal, surface, kind, model, category and levelObject, with distance in metres from the feet.
weaponHit.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("weaponHit", function(hit)
  if hit.category == "rock" then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Your blade rings on the stone.")
  end
end)

locationDiscovered.summary: The player discovered a map location, such as a town or district. It happens only on a server with revealMap off, since otherwise the whole map starts discovered. Keep the GUID with the character, and mark it again after the next load. Handler promises are not awaited.
args: The GUID's data1, data2, data3 and the eight bytes of data4.

poiDiscovered.summary: The player discovered a point of interest on the map, on a server with revealMap off. Handler promises are not awaited.
args: The GUID's data1, data2, data3 and the eight bytes of data4.
poiDiscovered.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("poiDiscovered", function(point)
  print("found " .. point.data1:toString(16))
end)

mapWaypointSet.summary: The local player set or moved their map waypoint.
args: True if an existing waypoint moved.
mapWaypointSet.exampleLua:
-- client: share the waypoint with the party
kcds.core.Events.on("mapWaypointSet", function(position)
  kcds.core.Events.toServer("party:waypoint", { x = position.x, y = position.y, z = position.z })
end)

mapWaypointCleared.summary: The local player removed their waypoint.

bookOpened.summary: A Book opened in this player's game.
bookOpened.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("bookOpened", function()
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Press Escape to put the letter down.")
end)

bookClosed.exampleLua:

kcds.core.Events.on("bookClosed", function(id, reason)
  if reason == "player" then
    kcds.core.Events.toServer("letters:read", { id = id })
  end
end)

bookTextChanged.summary: The text in an open book changed.
bookTextChanged.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("bookTextChanged", function(id, text)
  if #text > 500 then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("The page is full.")
  end
end)

bookWritingEnded.summary: The player stopped writing in a book.
bookWritingEnded.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("bookWritingEnded", function(id, text)
  kcds.core.Events.toServer("letters:write", { text = text })
end)

args: The chosen look with 'accepted', otherwise null.
characterCreatorClosed.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("characterCreatorClosed", function(appearance, reason)
  if reason == "accepted" then
    kcds.core.Events.toServer("looks:save", appearance)
  end
end)

characterCreatorChanged.summary: The character creator's figure shows another look: a choice in its panel, a random or reset look, or CharacterCreator.preview. An editor of your own follows it to show what is chosen.
args: The look the figure shows now, { gender, body, head, hair, beard }.

tutorialHintClosed.summary: A tutorial hint in the corner of the screen closed.
tutorialHintClosed.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("tutorialHintClosed", function(id)
  if id == fishingHint then
    kcds.core.Events.toServer("tutorial:seen", "fishing")
  end
end)

monologueSuppressed.summary: KCDS silenced one of the local character's remarks, which the game voices as Henry whoever plays. Hud.setInnerVoice(true) lets them speak. The line is chosen from the remark's pool, as the game would.
args: The line in the player's language, or '' if the game has none for it.
The line's localization key, or the remark's metarole name if it has no line.
monologueSuppressed.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("monologueSuppressed", function(text)
  if text then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("(you think) " .. text)
  end
end)

storyCutsceneSuppressed.summary: Client only. KCDS stopped a quest's story cutscene playing on this machine. The player stays in control, the world clock runs on, and the quest continues as if it had played. Hud.setCutscenes(true) lets them play.
args: Its name in the game's cutscene table.
storyCutsceneSuppressed.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("storyCutsceneSuppressed", function(cutscene)
  print("skipped the cutscene " .. tostring(cutscene))
end)

gameResolutionChanged.summary: Client only. The game's frame changed size, because the player switched between window and full screen or changed resolution. It fires once per change, and not for the first size.
gameResolutionChanged.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("gameResolutionChanged", function(width, height)
  print("The game is now " .. tostring(width) .. " x " .. tostring(height))
end)

actionHintsChanged.summary: Client only. The HUD's hints changed: one appeared or went, its text changed, it was greyed out, or a hold ring moved. ActionHint.shown() reads the new set.

vendorOpened.summary: A server vendor's shop screen opened in this player's game.
vendorOpened.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("vendorOpened", function()
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Prices on this server differ from the game.")
end)

vendorClosed.summary: A shop screen closed. The server's handler gets (vendorId, player, reason), and the player's game gets (session, reason).
args: The vendor on the server, the trade session on the client.
On the server: 0 the player closed it, 1 the server did, 2 another shop opened, 3 failed, 4 the player left.
vendorClosed.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("vendorClosed", function(vendor, player, reason)
  if player and reason == 0 then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Come again!")
  end
end)

vendorTrade.summary: A player traded with a vendor: the server settled their basket. Each line of `bought` and `sold` is { item, name, amount, price, metadata }: the item's class id and name, the units, the vendor's price of one unit, and the item's metadata (quality, health).
args: The shelf rows they bought, as lines.
Their items the vendor bought, as lines.
The money the player got, in money units; negative: what they paid. Without a haggle it is what the sold lines pay minus what the bought lines cost.
True when the basket settled at a price agreed in the haggle: then the balance is minus the agreed price, and the lines keep the vendor's own prices.
vendorTrade.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("vendorTrade", function(vendorId, player, bought, sold, balance, haggled)
  local items = {}
  for _, line in ipairs(bought) do
    table.insert(items, line.amount .. " " .. line.name)
  end
  local how = haggled and "after haggling" or "at list price"
  print(player.nickname .. " bought " .. table.concat(items, ", ") .. " and paid " .. tostring(-balance) .. " " .. how)
end)

vendorHaggle.summary: A player offered a price in the haggle of a vendor created with `haggle` (the game's own haggle with the trader). Prices are what the player pays, in money units; negative: what the vendor pays. Return true or { accept: true } to take the offer, { counter: price, mood? } to ask another price (mood 0 calm to 1 about to leave), false or { refuse: true } to haggle no more in this session, or nothing to leave the offer to the next handler and then to the vendor's own rule. The game shows the answer: the trader's reply, the new price and the mood on the haggle panel. A counter at or below the offer takes the offer.
args: { bought, sold, balance, price, asked, round, mood }: the lines as in vendorTrade, the list balance, the list price (minus the balance), the vendor's last price, this offer's round (1 the first) and the trader's mood, 0 to 1.

dialogueChoice.summary: A player chose an option in a conversation from Dialogue.open.
dialogueChoice.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("dialogueChoice", function(session, player, option)
  if option == "buy" then
    kcds.characters.Vendor.open(smith, player, blacksmithNpc)
  end
  kcds.characters.Dialogue.close(session)
end)

questTrackingChanged.summary: A player started or stopped tracking a quest in their quest menu.
questTrackingChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("questTrackingChanged", function(quest, player, tracked)
  if tracked then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Now tracking: " .. tostring(quest.title))
  end
end)

cameraPathFinished.summary: Client only. A Camera.playPath reached its last key; the view holds there until Camera.endShot.

cameraShotEnded.summary: A Camera.startShot ended by itself. The server's handler gets (player, reason), and the player's game gets (reason).

entityStateChange.summary: A value in an entity's shared state changed.
entityStateChange.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("entityStateChange", function(entity, key, value)
  -- a player has a nickname, other entities do not
  if key == "wanted" and value == true and entity.nickname ~= nil then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(entity.nickname .. " is wanted!")
  end
end)

horseMounting.summary: A player mounts a horse, before the server accepts it. Handlers run synchronously, and returning false has their client dismount them, with no horseMount or horseDismount.
horseMounting.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseMounting", function(horse, player)
  if horse.ownerId and horse.ownerId ~= player.id then
    return false
  end
end)

horseMount.summary: A player sat in a horse's saddle, by themselves or through player.mount.
args: The rider, or null if they left the server.
horseMount.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseMount", function(horse, player)
  if player and horse.ownerId ~= player.id then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "That is not your horse!")
  end
end)

horseDismount.summary: A rider left a horse's saddle, for any reason.
args: The rider, or null if they left the server.
horseDismount.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseDismount", function(horse, player)
  if player then
    print(player.nickname .. " got off " .. horse.name)
  end
end)

horseGearChanging.summary: A horse's owner changed its tack on the inventory screen's Horse tab, before the server takes it. Return false to refuse, so the horse keeps its gear on all clients and no item moves. It does not fire while the horse's gearFixed is set, which refuses first, or for a script's setTack, fitGear or takeOffGear.
args: What it would wear: { saddle, head, torso, shoe }, item class names or null.
horseGearChanging.exampleLua:
-- Stable horses keep their saddles. stableHorses is your resource's Set of ids.
kcds.core.Events.on("horseGearChanging", function(horse)
  if stableHorses:has(horse.id) then
    return false
  end
end)

horseGearChanged.summary: A horse's tack changed on all clients.
args: The rider responsible, or null after a script's setTack, fitGear or takeOffGear.
What it wears now: { saddle, head, torso, shoe }.

horseOwnerChanged.summary: A horse got a new owner, or none.
horseOwnerChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseOwnerChanged", function(horse, owner)
  if owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(owner, horse.name .. " is yours now.")
  end
end)

horseDamage.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseDamage", function(horse, attacker)
  if attacker and horse.ownerId and horse.ownerId ~= attacker.id then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(attacker, "That is not your horse!")
  end
end)

horseDeath.summary: A horse died, and only revive() brings it back.
args: 'scripted' if a resource did it, otherwise 'unknown'.
horseDeath.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseDeath", function(horse)
  if horse.owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(horse.owner, horse.name .. " died.")
  end
end)

horseKnockedOut.summary: A horse was knocked out, by a lethal blow when spawned with knockOut, or by knockDown(). Nobody can ride it until wake().
args: 'scripted' if a resource did it, otherwise 'unknown'.

horseRevive.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseRevive", function(horse)
  if horse.owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(horse.owner, horse.name .. " is back on its feet.")
  end
end)

horseIntentDone.summary: A horse finished a moveTo or patrol order.
horseIntentDone.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("horseIntentDone", function(horse, status)
  if status ~= "reached" then
    print(horse.name .. " did not arrive: " .. tostring(status))
  end
end)

dogDestroy.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("dogDestroy", function(dog)
  if dog.owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(dog.owner, tostring(dog.name) .. " is gone.")
  end
end)

dogOwnerChanged.summary: A dog got a new owner, or none.
dogOwnerChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("dogOwnerChanged", function(dog, owner)
  if owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(owner, tostring(dog.name) .. " follows you now.")
  end
end)

dogModeChanged.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("dogModeChanged", function(dog, mode)
  if mode == 3 and dog.owner then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(dog.owner, tostring(dog.name) .. " attacks!")
  end
end)

args: The player or NPC responsible, or null.

For a person, 'head', 'torso', 'leftArm', 'rightArm', 'leftLeg' or 'rightLeg'. For an animal, 'head', 'torso', 'eyes' on a dog, 'frontLegs', 'backLegs', 'legs', or 'feet' on a horse. null for none in particular.
npcDamage.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("npcDamage", function(npc, attacker)
  if attacker and npc.name == "Captain" then
    npc:attack(attacker)
  end
end)

npcDeath.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("npcDeath", function(npc, killer)
  if killer and npc.name == "Bandit chief" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(killer.nickname .. " defeated the bandit chief!")
  end
end)

npcInteract.summary: A player pressed the use key looking at an NPC with `interactable` on, within 3.5 m of their view. The server also checks that they stand near it.
npcInteract.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("npcInteract", function(npc, player)
  if npc == innkeeper then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "What will it be?")
  end
end)

npcAnimationEnd.summary: An animation from npc.playAnimation ended, firing once per request. A looping one ends only by 'refused', 'stopped' or 'replaced'.
args: The fragment requested, often '' if a clip was given.

'finished' when a one-shot reached its end; 'interrupted' when something else, such as a hit or fall, took the body's clip; 'refused' when the body lacks that clip or fragment; 'stopped' by stopAnimation; 'replaced' by the next playAnimation.
npcAnimationEnd.exampleLua:
-- The smith hammers, then returns to his rounds.
smith:playAnimation("hammer", { clip = "reading_stand_inv_in" })

kcds.core.Events.on("npcAnimationEnd", function(npc, fragment, reason)
  if npc == smith and reason == "finished" then
    smith:patrol("smithy")
  end
end)

npcIntentDone.summary: An NPC finished a moveTo, a follow or a patrol leg.
npcIntentDone.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("npcIntentDone", function(npc, status)
  if status == "blocked" then
    npc:teleport(npc.position)
  end
end)

args: { revision, reason, items: [{ id, before, after }] }.

npcSimulatorChange.summary: Another player's game now simulates the NPC, moving it and running its fights.
args: The player now simulating it, or null.

npcHarvest.summary: A player finished butchering a carcass and is about to get its harvest. Return false to refuse, or { items: [{ item, amount }] }, up to 16 rows, to replace the harvest table's yield this time. A wrong yield is logged and the table's is given.
npcHarvest.exampleLua:
-- Only hunters butcher.
kcds.core.Events.on("npcHarvest", function(player)
  if player.state:get("job") ~= "hunter" then
    return false
  end
end)

npcHarvested.summary: A player got a carcass's harvest.

npcLoot.summary: A player is about to take an item from a dead NPC. Return false to refuse.
npcLoot.exampleLua:
-- The captain's seal stays on his body.
kcds.core.Events.on("npcLoot", function(player, npc, line)
  if npc.name == "Captain" and line.item == sealItemId then
    return false
  end
end)

npcLooted.summary: A player took items from a dead NPC.

patrolWaypoint.summary: An NPC on patrol reached a waypoint, or a leg failed.
args: { routeId, waypointIndex, lap, direction, phase, status }.
patrolWaypoint.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("patrolWaypoint", function(npc, patrol)
  if patrol.waypointIndex == 0 then
    npc:say("All quiet at the gate.")
  end
end)

patrolFinished.summary: An NPC's patrol ended: done, cancelled or given up.
args: { routeId, waypointIndex, lap, direction, phase, status }.
patrolFinished.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("patrolFinished", function(npc, patrol)
  if patrol.status ~= "reached" then
    npc:patrol(patrol.routeId)
  end
end)

areaEnter.summary: A player, horse or NPC entered an area, by its shape, in any dimension. The area is the level's, such as a house, interior, private ground or settlement, or a resource's. It also fires when an area is created, moved or enabled around a body.
areaEnter.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("areaEnter", function(area, entity)
  if area.kind ~= "level" then
    return
  end
  for _, label in ipairs(area.labels) do
    if label == "interior" then
      print(entity.id .. " went inside: " .. area.name)
    end
  end
end)
args: True if the area belongs to the body's dimension or to none, as level areas do.

areaExit.summary: A player, horse or NPC left an area, or the area was destroyed or disabled around it, or the server's map changed.
areaExit.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("areaExit", function(area, entity)
  for _, label in ipairs(area.labels) do
    if label == "private" then
      print(entity.id .. " left " .. area.name)
    end
  end
end)
args: True if the area belongs to the body's dimension or to none, as level areas do.

markerEnter.summary: A player walked into a trigger marker.
markerEnter.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("markerEnter", function(marker, player)
  if marker == tavernDoor then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Welcome to the tavern.")
  end
end)

markerExit.summary: A player left a trigger marker.
markerExit.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("markerExit", function(marker, player)
  if marker == arena then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You left the arena.")
  end
end)

playerMissileHit.summary: A player's arrow, bolt or ball came to rest in the world, as their own game saw it, after it became the ground stack others can pick up. `hit` is { position, item, stuck, stack, entity, surface, kind, model, entityGuid, entityName, entityClass, levelObject }: where it lies, its ammunition class, whether it stuck in what it struck, the GroundItem it became or null, and what it struck there as World.raycast describes a hit, such as kind 'terrain' with surface 'mat_grass', or nulls and '' when the game found nothing. A shot that broke or struck a body raises none; playerHit reports hits on players.
args: Where it came to rest and what it struck.
playerMissileHit.exampleLua:
-- An archery range: arrows in the target score.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerMissileHit", function(player, hit)
  if hit.stuck and hit.entityName == "archery_target_1" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "A hit!")
  end
end)

doorDiscovered.summary: The server met a level door for the first time in this run: a player's game in that dimension built it and reported it. It fires once per door and dimension, and again after a server restart, since the server keeps no doors between runs. Lock it or give it a key here, and the reporting player gets that state before using it. Door.all() lists the doors met so far.
args: The player whose game reported it.
doorDiscovered.exampleLua:
-- Locks kept by a script come back with each door, also after a restart.
local locked = {}
kcds.core.Events.on("doorDiscovered", function(door)
  if (locked[door.guid] ~= nil) then
    door.locked = true
  end
end)

doorInteract.summary: A player is about to open, close, unlock or lockpick a door. Return false to refuse.
args: True if on the side with the key.
doorInteract.exampleLua:
-- The armoury opens only for guards.
kcds.core.Events.on("doorInteract", function(player, door, action)
  if action == "open" and door == armouryDoor and player.state:get("job") ~= "guard" then
    return false
  end
end)

gateChanged.summary: A gate moved to another state.

gateBarChanged.summary: A gate's bar was put in or taken out.

graveDug.summary: A player dug out a grave with the game's digging. All games show it open from now on.

tabletopSit.summary: A player is about to sit at a Tabletop, by their request or table.sit. Return false to refuse.
tabletopSit.exampleLua: kcds.core.Events.on("tabletopSit", function(table, player) return table.state == "idle" end)

tabletopSeated.summary: A player sat down at a Tabletop: the moment to start a game once every seat is taken.
tabletopSeated.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("tabletopSeated", function(table)
  if table.state ~= "idle" then
    return
  end
  for _, seat in ipairs(table.seats) do
    if not seat.player then
      return
    end
  end
  table:start()
end)

tabletopCellClick.summary: A seated player clicked a cell (whose turn it is, while a game is on), before the table picks or moves a piece. Return false to take the click yourself, as a game that places pieces does.
tabletopCellClick.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("tabletopCellClick", function(table, player, cell)
  if table:pieceAt(cell) == nil then
    table:addPiece({ model = "dicebadge_balatro_badge_gold", cell = cell, side = "x" })
  end
  return false
end)

tabletopLeave.summary: A player left a Tabletop's seat: 'stood' (the hint or table.stand), 'disconnect' or 'removed' (the table went).

tabletopPieceSelect.summary: A seated player picked a piece in their game (whose turn it is, while a game is on). Return false to refuse; otherwise the table marks it for them.

tabletopMoveRequest.summary: A seated player asks to move their picked piece to a cell. Return false to refuse; otherwise the piece hops there. Passing the turn is yours (table.nextTurn).

tabletopStart.summary: A game started at a Tabletop (table.start).

tabletopTurn.summary: The turn went to a seat.

tabletopTurnTimeout.summary: A turn's time (turnSeconds) ran out. Return false to keep the turn for another while; otherwise it passes.

tabletopForfeit.summary: A player left a game in play and lost it. With one player left, the game then ends with them as the winner.

tabletopEnd.summary: A game ended (table.finish, a forfeit or the table's removal). The winner has taken the pot.

deckSelect.summary: A player holding pieces of a TabletopDeck selects one (their select key) or lets it back into the fan. Return false to refuse.
args: True to select it, false to let it back.
deckSelect.exampleLua:
-- One piece at a time.
kcds.core.Events.on("deckSelect", function(deck, player, piece, selected)
  return not selected or #deck:selected(player) == 0
end)

deckPlayRequest.summary: A player asks to play pieces of their hand (their play key): the selected ones, else the one they point at. Return false to refuse; otherwise their right hand throws them onto the deck's play pile. Your game's rules go here.

deckDrawRequest.summary: A player presses their draw key (when the deck has one, setActions). Return false to refuse; otherwise one piece flies from the stack into their hand.
deckDrawRequest.exampleLua: kcds.core.Events.on("deckDrawRequest", function(deck, player) return deck.table:seatOf(player) == deck.table.turn end)

deckPass.summary: A player presses their pass key (Space): a pass, a check or a stand, as your game names it with setActions. Nothing else happens; the rest is yours.
deckPass.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("deckPass", function(deck, player)
  if deck.table:seatOf(player) == deck.table.turn then
    deck.table:nextTurn()
  end
end)

deckCover.summary: A player lays their hand face down on the table (their cover key), covered true, or takes it up again, false. Return false to refuse.
args: True to lay it down, false to take it up.

stashSpawn.summary: A stash, meaning a chest, container or searchable body, was created.

stashInteract.summary: A player is about to open a stash. Return false to refuse.
stashInteract.exampleLua:
-- The guild chest opens only for members.
kcds.core.Events.on("stashInteract", function(player, stash)
  if stash == guildChest and player.state:get("guild") ~= "merchants" then
    return false
  end
end)

stashUnlocked.summary: A player unlocked a locked stash.
stashUnlocked.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("stashUnlocked", function(stash, player, method)
  if method == "lockpick" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll("Someone picked the lock of " .. stash.name .. "!")
  end
end)

stashInventoryChanged.summary: A script changed a stash's contents.
args: Always null for a script's change.

groundItemSpawn.summary: A stack of items appeared on the ground.
groundItemSpawn.exampleLua:
-- Arrows and dropped loot vanish after ten minutes.
kcds.core.Events.on("groundItemSpawn", function(stack)
  setTimeout(function() return stack:destroy() end, 10 * 60 * 1000)
end)

groundItemResting.summary: A ground item came to rest where physics laid it. Its position and rotation are that spot on all clients, and `resting` is true. It fires once per stack, and not for a landed arrow or bolt, which rests from the start.

groundItemDestroy.summary: A ground item is being removed.

groundItemPickup.summary: A player picked up a ground item.

worldItemPickup.summary: A player is about to pick up an item the level placed. Return false to refuse.
worldItemPickup.exampleLua:
-- The goods on the market stalls are not free.
kcds.core.Events.on("worldItemPickup", function(player, item)
  if marketSquare:contains(item.position) then
    return false
  end
end)

gatheringHarvest.summary: A player picked a plant and is about to get it. Return false to refuse.
args: { item, amount, kind, position: [x, y, z], dimension }.
gatheringHarvest.exampleLua:
-- No picking in the monastery garden's dimension.
kcds.core.Events.on("gatheringHarvest", function(player, proposal)
  if proposal.dimension == 7 then
    return false
  end
end)

gatheringHarvested.summary: A player got what they picked.
args: The proposal's fields, as for gatheringHarvest, plus items, the inventory rows that got it.

propRest.summary: A rigid prop came to rest, whatever moved it: a script call such as applyImpulse, setVelocity, wake or sleep, a fall, or a player. The position comes from the client simulating it, the nearest player's at any distance, and other players already see it there. A position over 100 m from the previous resting or spawn point is refused, returning the prop there with no event. resetPhysics fires no event.
propRest.exampleLua:
-- A barrel off the cart stays where it fell.
kcds.core.Events.on("propRest", function(prop, position)
  if prop.model:endsWith("barrel_a.cgf") then
    prop.physics = "static"
  end
  print("prop " .. tostring(prop.id) .. " rests at " .. tostring(position))
end)

propHit.summary: A rigid prop's body struck something, such as the ground, a wall or another body. The simulating game saw it, moving at 2 m/s or more, slow down with its velocity changing by 2 m/s or more between frames, which gravity alone cannot do. There is at most one hit per prop every 0.3 s, and propRest still follows once it stops.
args: The speed before the hit, in m/s.
Where it is after the hit.
propHit.exampleLua:
-- A kicked barrel breaks when it lands hard.
kcds.core.Events.on("propHit", function(prop, speed, position)
  if speed < 6 or not prop.model:endsWith("barrel_a.cgf") then
    return
  end
  print("barrel " .. tostring(prop.id) .. " broke at " .. tostring(position) .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f", speed) .. " m/s)")
  prop:destroy()
end)

propPlaceMove.summary: A player moved a PropPlacer preview, if the placer reports moves.
propPlaceMove.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("propPlaceMove", function(player, session, placement, valid)
  if not valid then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "It does not fit there.")
  end
end)

propPlaceConfirm.summary: A player confirmed a placement. Return false to refuse, and propPlaceRejected follows.
propPlaceConfirm.exampleLua:
-- Nothing in the water.
kcds.core.Events.on("propPlaceConfirm", function(player, session, placement)
  if placement.surface == "water" then
    return false
  end
end)

cartSpawn.summary: A cart or wagon was spawned.

cartDestroy.summary: A cart is being removed, with everyone on it let off first.

cartEntering.summary: A player is about to take a seat on a cart. Return false to refuse.
cartEntering.exampleLua:
-- Only the owner drives. cartOwners is your resource's Map of cart id to player id.
kcds.core.Events.on("cartEntering", function(cart, player, seat)
  if seat == "driver" and cartOwners:get(cart.id) ~= player.id then
    return false
  end
end)

cartEnter.summary: A player took a seat on a cart.
cartEnter.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("cartEnter", function(cart, player, seat)
  if seat == "driver" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You hold the reins.")
  end
end)

cartExit.summary: A player left a cart's seat.

vfxDestroy.summary: A visual effect is being removed.

worldDayChange.summary: The world's clock reached a new day.

craftingStationUsed.summary: A player used a Crafting station with more than one recipe, and your resource chooses what they craft.
craftingStationUsed.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingStationUsed", function(player, data)
  local station = data.station
  if station == smokehouse then
    kcds.world.Crafting.craft(player, station, "smoked_boar")
  end
end)

craftingStarting.summary: A player is about to start crafting. Return false to refuse.
args: The kind, 'alchemy', 'smithing' or 'custom', the station, recipe and dimension.
craftingStarting.exampleLua:
-- Smithing only for the smiths' guild.
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingStarting", function(player, proposal)
  if proposal.kind == "smithing" and player.state:get("guild") ~= "smiths" then
    return false
  end
end)

craftingStarted.summary: A player started an alchemy batch, a smithing workpiece or a custom recipe.
args: { kind, session, station, dimension, recipe, continuationOf }.

craftingCompleting.summary: A craft is about to give its product. Return false to refuse, and the product is taken back.
args: { kind, recipe, product, amount, grade, quality, xp, ... }.
craftingCompleting.exampleLua:
-- No potions above grade 3 on this server.
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingCompleting", function(player, proposal)
  if proposal.kind == "alchemy" and proposal.grade > 3 then
    return false
  end
end)

args: { kind, session, station, outcome, recipe, grade, quality, xp, outputs, dimension, ... }.

craftingRefunding.summary: An unfinished craft is settling. Call refund() to return all materials still held, and otherwise the game's rules apply.
args: The session, outcome, reason and materials held.
craftingRefunding.exampleLua:
-- A cancelled or failed batch returns all its materials.
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingRefunding", function(player, details, refund)
  refund()
end)

args: { kind, session, station, dimension, outcome, reason, refunded }.
craftingEnded.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingEnded", function(player, details)
  if details.outcome == "cancelled" then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You left the station.")
  end
end)

craftingRecipeLearned.summary: A player learned a custom recipe.
craftingRecipeLearned.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("craftingRecipeLearned", function(player, data)
  local recipe = data.recipe
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You learned " .. tostring(recipe) .. ".")
end)

diceTableUse.summary: A player used a dice table.
args: The id of their match, or 0.
diceTableUse.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("diceTableUse", function(player, table, match)
  if match == 0 then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Find an opponent and sit down.")
  end
end)

voiceTalkingChanged.summary: A player started or stopped talking in voice chat.

voiceTierRequest.summary: A player asked to talk in another tier. Return false to refuse.
voiceTierRequest.exampleCs: Events.On("voiceTierRequest", object? (Player player, string tier) => tier != "shout");

diceMatchStarting.summary: A dice match is about to begin, for example because a second player sat down at a table where another waited. Change `options` here to set the match: `targetScore`, names, dice and badges, as Dice.start and Dice.startAgainstNpc take them. It runs for every match, also one the shipped dice resource starts.
args: The second player, or null against the server's NPC.
The options the match will start with. Changes to this object count.
{ match, player, seat, turn, roll, turnScore, totalScore, ... }.
The match state, with faces, and reason 'bust' if nothing scores.
diceRoll.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("diceRoll", function(event)
  if event.reason == "bust" then
    print("seat " .. tostring(event.seat) .. " went bust")
  end
end)

diceSettled.summary: The dice of a throw lie still on the table. It is the same throw as its diceRoll, which comes when the dice are dealt and still roll; this one comes once the thrower's game has shown them still for half a second, or four seconds after the throw at the latest, so a score panel waits for it instead of guessing.
args: The match state of the throw, as its diceRoll had it.

diceMove.summary: A player held dice and continued or passed.
args: The match state, with points, and reason 'continue', 'pass' or 'badgePass'.

diceBadge.summary: A badge took effect on a throw.
args: The match state, with reason, the effect, and points, what it added.
The match state, with reason 'won', 'bust', 'pass' or why the match ended.
The first player, or null if gone.
The second player, or null if gone.
The winning seat, 0 or 1, if any.
diceMatchEnd.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("diceMatchEnd", function(match, first, second, winner, reason, firstScore, secondScore)
  local players = { first, second }
  local champion = (winner == 0 or winner == 1 and players[winner] or null)
  if champion then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(tostring(champion.nickname) .. " won at dice " .. tostring(firstScore) .. ":" .. tostring(secondScore))
  end
end)

siegeEngineDestroy.summary: A siege engine is being removed.

siegeEngineUse.summary: A player is about to operate a siege engine. Return false to refuse.
siegeEngineUse.exampleLua:
-- Only the attackers work the trebuchet.
kcds.core.Events.on("siegeEngineUse", function(player)
  if player.state:get("team") ~= "attackers" then
    return false
  end
end)

siegeEngineReady.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("siegeEngineReady", function(engine)
  if engine.operator then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(engine.operator, "Loaded. Fire when ready!")
  end
end)

siegeLadderDestroy.summary: A siege ladder is being removed.

siegeLadderUse.summary: A player is about to push away or raise a ladder. Return false to refuse.
siegeLadderUse.exampleLua:
-- Defenders only push ladders away, and attackers only raise them.
kcds.core.Events.on("siegeLadderUse", function(player, ladder, action)
  local team = player.state:get("team")
  if action == "raise" and team ~= "attackers" then
    return false
  end
  if action == "push" and team ~= "defenders" then
    return false
  end
end)

siegeLadderRaise.summary: A ladder was raised against a wall.

siegeLadderFall.summary: A ladder was pushed away and fell.
siegeLadderFall.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("siegeLadderFall", function(ladder, pusher)
  if pusher then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll(tostring(pusher.nickname) .. " pushed a ladder off the wall!")
  end
end)

stonePileDestroy.summary: A stone pile is being removed.

stonePileThrow.summary: A player threw a stone from a pile.
stonePileThrow.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("stonePileThrow", function(player, pile)
  if pile.stones == 0 then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "That was the last stone.")
  end
end)

stoneImpact.summary: A thrown stone landed, hurting anyone near.
args: The pile, or null if gone.

followStarted.summary: Client only. The local player's scripted follow started.
followStarted.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("followStarted", function(target)
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Following " .. target.nickname)
end)

followStopped.summary: Client only. The local player's follow ended.
followStopped.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("followStopped", function(target, reason)
  if reason == "targetLost" then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification(target.nickname .. " is gone")
  end
end)

playerPreparing.summary: A player's game is about to cook, smoke or dry food at a fire, smokehouse or rack. Return false to refuse, so nothing starts and nothing is taken. The game still plays the player's animation and tells them nothing, so show a message of your own.
args: { kind: 'cooking' | 'smoking' | 'drying', position, dimension, station }, where station is the SmartObject.stations id of the level's rack or smokehouse, or null at a fire. The items come with playerPrepared, once the game has chosen and converted them.
playerPreparing.exampleLua:
-- The tavern's fire is for the cook only.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPreparing", function(player, preparing)
  if preparing.kind == "cooking" and player.state:get("job") ~= "cook" then
    return false
  end
end)

playerPrepared.summary: A preparation playerPreparing allowed is over. It fires once the inventory has been still for a few seconds after the last conversion, and not if nothing converted.
args: { kind, position, dimension, station, items }, with items as [{ id, the row it came from; item; amount; product, null if none matched }], each stack lost paired with the product gained in the same amount.
playerPrepared.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerPrepared", function(player, preparation)
  for _, row in ipairs(preparation.items) do
    print(player.nickname .. " made " .. tostring(row.amount) .. " " .. tostring(row.product) .. " from " .. tostring(row.item))
  end
end)

playerQueued.summary: A player joined a full server's queue.
args: { id, nickname, steamId, ip, waitedSeconds, priority }.
playerQueued.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerQueued", function(entry)
  if supporters:has(entry.steamId) then
    kcds.core.Queue.setPriority(entry.id, 10)
  end
end)

tradeOpen.summary: A trade between two players is about to open. Return false to refuse.
tradeOpen.exampleLua:
-- No trading during a duel.
kcds.core.Events.on("tradeOpen", function(seller, buyer)
  if seller.state:get("inDuel") or buyer.state:get("inDuel") then
    return false
  end
end)

tradeItem.summary: The buyer confirmed a basket. Return false to refuse.
tradeItem.exampleLua:
-- At most 10 of anything in one basket.
kcds.core.Events.on("tradeItem", function(seller, buyer, bought)
  for _, line in ipairs(bought) do
    if line.amount > 10 then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end)

tradeDone.summary: A basket went through, and both inventories changed.
args: [{ item, name, amount, price, metadata }] bought.

playerTreeChop.summary: A player's axe blow on a standing tree counts: axe in hand, within reach, one per swing. Return false to refuse. See Trees.
args: The Tree, with id, species, position, hits, state and more.
{ number, of, position }: this blow's number, the blows that fell it, and where it landed.
playerTreeChop.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerTreeChop", function(player, tree, blow)
  -- The holy grove.
  if tree.position:distance(kcds.math.Vector3.new(500, 500, 30)) < 30 then
    return false
  end
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, tostring(blow.number) .. " / " .. tostring(blow.of))
end)

playerTreeFell.summary: A player's last blow fells a tree. You can change `fall.direction`, which is horizontal and away from the chopper by default, and `fall.seconds`. Return false to keep it standing, and the next blow tries again.
playerTreeFell.exampleLua:
-- Always north, across the road.
kcds.core.Events.on("playerTreeFell", function(player, tree, fall)
  fall.direction = kcds.math.Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
end)

playerTrunkChop.summary: A player's axe blow on a felled trunk counts. Return false to refuse.

playerTrunkCut.summary: A player's last blow cuts a felled trunk into items, and you can change `items` in place. Return false to refuse, and the next blow tries again. The items go to the inventory or the ground, by Trees.configure's dropTo, and the trunk disappears.
playerTrunkCut.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerTrunkCut", function(player, tree, items)
  if string.find(tree.species, "quercus", 1, true) then
    table.insert(items, { item = "bsmt_woodExotic", amount = 2 })
  end
end)

treeFelled.summary: A felled trunk came to rest, and lies as a static prop to be cut. See Trees. It fires on the server and, for players of its dimension, in client scripts.
args: The tree: id, species, position, dimension and state 'felled'.

treeRegrow.summary: A felled or cut tree is about to grow back, with its time up and nobody close. Return false to delay it by a minute.
treeRegrow.exampleLua:
-- Trees return by day only.
kcds.core.Events.on("treeRegrow", function()
  return kcds.world.World.hour >= 6
end)

treeRegrown.summary: A felled tree stands again as in the level. See Trees. It fires on the server and, for players of its dimension, in client scripts.

treeChop.summary: Client only. Any player's counted axe blow on a standing tree in this dimension. Handler promises are not awaited.
args: The tree: id, species, position, dimension and state.
treeChop.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("treeChop", function(tree, blow)
  if blow.number == blow.of - 1 then
    kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("The tree creaks.")
  end
end)

treeFalling.summary: Client only. A tree in this dimension starts to fall, for `fall.seconds` along `fall.direction`, a good moment for a sound or dust. Handler promises are not awaited.
treeFalling.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("treeFalling", function(tree, fall)
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("Timber! (" .. string.format("%.1f", fall.seconds) .. " s)")
end)

trunkCut.summary: Client only. A felled trunk in this dimension was cut into items. Handler promises are not awaited.
trunkCut.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("trunkCut", function(tree, items)
  print(tostring(tree.id) .. " gave " .. tostring(#items) .. " kinds of items")
end)
